entries.en: Found something. Section of the docks that's Maelstrom turf.
entries.ro: Am găsit ceva. Un colț din docuri care e teritoriu Maelstrom.

entries.en: V? Got to the bottom of "Ebunike."
So you found Grayson. He really got an in with Smasher?
entries.en_m: Meanin' you found Grayson? He really got an in with Smasher?
entries.ro: Deci l-ai găsit pe Grayson. Chiar are pile la Smasher?
entries.ro_m: Adică l-ai găsit pe Grayson? Chiar are pile la Smasher?

entries.en: Come see me – Afterlife. We'll talk.
entries.ro: Vino să mă vezi – Afterlife. Vorbim.

entries.en: So why're these docks called "Ebunike"? Pretty sure it's got nothin' to do with some long-dead mayor.
entries.ro: Deci de ce se numesc docurile astea „Ebunike”? Pun pariu că n-are nimic de-a face cu vreun primar mort de mult.

entries.en: Dead wrong, actually. It's not the docks, it's an old container ship named after the guy.
entries.ro: Ba deloc. Nu sunt docurile, ci o navă container veche care poartă numele tipului.

entries.en: Flicked pings to some contacts. Grayson buzzed familiar for a friend from the olden days. He did some digging.
entries.ro: Am dat ping la câteva contacte. Grayson mi s-a părut cunoscut, un prieten de pe vremuri. A cercetat niște chestii.

entries.en: So you've found Grayson. Any leads on Smasher?
entries.ro: Deci l-ai găsit pe Grayson. Ai vreun pont despre Smasher?
